rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for a scientist who studies astronomy or astrophysics.

example.english: I'm an astronomer who studies stars and the universe.
example.traditional: 我係研究星體同宇宙嘅天文學家。
example.jyutping: ngo5 hai6 jin4 gau3 sing1 tai2 tung4 jyu5 zau6 ge3 tin1 man4 hok6 gaa1
